translation: For deficient persons who cannot be purged, one should use Four Substances Decoction (四物湯) with added pangolin (穿山甲). If the stagnant blood has already been removed, then use Restorative Qi-Penetrating Powder (復元通氣散) with added dang gui (當歸) to regulate it. The Inner Classic (內經) says: When the form (形) is injured, it causes pain; when qi is injured, it causes swelling.
